default_when_silent.quote: In unsupervised assessments (essays, reports, coursework, projects, dissertations, portfolios), you can use GenAI, but you must acknowledge it. If your course documentation says nothing about GenAI, this default applies.

course co-ordinators can still indicate, on an assessment-by-assessment basis, any limitations on the use of AI
Your course can set additional limits, and those take precedence – so always read your assessment brief.

duty.quote: If you make use of AI at any point in your research or writing process, you must acknowledge the use of that tool as you would any other piece of evidence or material in your submission.

location.quote: When you’ve used Gen AI, you should include a statement to make this clear to your marker.
